name: Do I really need to widen the doorway, or can I just remove the door?

mainEntity.name: Do I really need to widen the doorway, or can I just remove the door?

acceptedAnswer.text: A common objection is, “Can’t I just leave the door off?” Sometimes that helps temporarily, but it does not solve the opening width, threshold, or swing problems that affect safe access. A proper accessibility modification is usually more useful if you want the home to work long term.
acceptedAnswer.description: Removing the door can help in a pinch, but it usually does not fix the real accessibility issue. If the opening is too narrow, widening is the more complete solution.
